NYC on Your Time

Getting help shouldn’t mean missing work. NYC on Your Time shows when benefits and support services are available, making the case for more evening and weekend access that fits New Yorkers’ lives.

The collection includes in-person food, housing, cash, health coverage, employment and related support from public agencies and government-funded nonprofits across all five boroughs. It excludes DMV, passports and ordinary library services, but includes benefits desks inside libraries. Published schedules describe a typical week; missing service hours stay unknown, and each location links to its sources.
